ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity (white) to 40% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe consists of a dominant contiguous high-intensity white field with a narrow low-intensity black margin along the trailing edge. Right lobe contains a large, irregular low-intensity black patch extending from the median notch toward the posterior-lateral quadrant, surrounded by high-intensity white borders.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are present along the entire trailing edge boundary, with more pronounced jagged peaks on the medial portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave curve from the notch to the tips, while the overall lobe shape follows a backward sweep.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the two lobes, characterized by the irregular, high-contrast dark mass on the right lobe relative to the predominantly white left lobe.
